purpose: Frozen fair seven-method comparison after validation preflight and one formal test release.
supersedes: superseded_pre_static_dependency_fix: identical model/configuration evaluation attempted before a static dependency-boundary repair; retained for audit and not used for conclusions.
honesty_boundaries: One frozen training checkpoint exists per PPO candidate, so training-seed variability and its confidence interval are not estimable.
PPO legality at deployment depends on the action mask; masked legality is not claimed as a constraint learned solely by the policy.
Cross-scenario averages are descriptive; the JSON report contains same-scenario, same-environment-seed paired differences against the rule reference.
No composite score or overall winner is asserted.
